title: Bunny waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='22' rx='8' ry='18' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='22' rx='5' ry='14' fill='#f0b8c8'/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='22' rx='8' ry='18' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='22' rx='5' ry='14' fill='#f0b8c8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='20' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='53' r='5' fill='#f0b8c8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='53' r='5' fill='#f0b8c8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='45' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='45' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#e88a9a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 54 Q46 58 43 56' stroke='#c07585' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 54 Q54 58 57 56' stroke='#c07585' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#fffaf2'/>
  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='73' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#f5e6d3' transform='rotate(15 34 73)'/>
  <!-- right arm (waving up) -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='60' rx='5' ry='9' fill='#f5e6d3' transform='rotate(-35 70 60)'/>
  <!-- right paw -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='53' r='4' fill='#f0d8c0'/>
  <!-- left paw -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='4' fill='#f0d8c0'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='89' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f0d8c0'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='89' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f0d8c0'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='32' y1='52' x2='24' y2='50' stroke='#d4b8a0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='32' y1='55' x2='24' y2='56' stroke='#d4b8a0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='52' x2='76' y2='50' stroke='#d4b8a0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='55' x2='76' y2='56' stroke='#d4b8a0' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- wave lines near paw -->
  <path d='M83 48 Q86 45 84 41' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M85 53 Q89 51 89 47' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
